notes: §1985:IV.6.2.3.1 prints ENVIRONMENT DIVISION., an optional CONFIGURATION SECTION of three optional paragraphs (SOURCE-COMPUTER, OBJECT-COMPUTER, SPECIAL-NAMES) and an optional section "INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION. FILE-CONTROL. file-control-entry" ... with I-O-CONTROL bracketed. The grammar (environmentDivision, configurationSection, inputOutputSection) fixes section and paragraph order, ClosedFormatPass.ScreenClauseRepetition (ClauseCardinality.ByClauseContext) refuses a configuration paragraph out of order (COBOL2987) or twice (COBOL2423), and since kb/Work PB5167 the 2002 relaxations are edition-gated: VersionConformancePass.VisitInputOutputSection refuses a section with no FILE-CONTROL or no entry (COBOL0900 file-control-entry-optional-2002) and VisitRepositoryParagraph an empty REPOSITORY (COBOL0900), both accepted at --std 2002. Probes at --std 85 (work-rs-02/c1): accepted ENVIRONMENT DIVISION alone, an empty CONFIGURATION SECTION, all five paragraphs with an empty I-O-CONTROL ('OK 3'); (b) refused INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION alone, FILE-CONTROL with no entry, I-O-CONTROL alone (COBOL0900), OBJECT-COMPUTER before SOURCE-COMPUTER and SPECIAL-NAMES before OBJECT-COMPUTER (COBOL2987), SOURCE-COMPUTER twice (COBOL2423), CONFIGURATION or INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION twice, INPUT-OUTPUT before CONFIGURATION, I-O-CONTROL before FILE-CONTROL (COBOL0001); (c) empty REPOSITORY refused at 85 (COBOL0900), the three 2002 forms accepted at --std 2002; (a,e) a RECORD VARYING file with an ODO record beside RELATIVE DYNAMIC and INDEXED RANDOM entries and SAME RECORD AREA compiles, a failed OPEN gives 35 and the READ after it 47. Classes d and f do not reach a division-structure format. Witness: empty SOURCE-COMPUTER and OBJECT-COMPUTER ('ENV OK'); pb5167 cases pin the two refusals. History: until the 1985 re-read 5 (2026-11-14) this row read PARTIAL, naming no kb/Work note; the re-read of main dc1f2dcce8 found that defect fixed by the landing of kb/Work PB5167 and records CONFORMS, upheld by an independent refuter (code read: op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-02.json, refuter op-20261114/out-reread5/rs-02-refute.json).
